definitions.explanation: The color green, as seen in leaves and grass.

examples.japanese: {緑色|みどりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{緑色|みどりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The traffic light changed to green.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緑色|みどりいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧だ。
examples.english: This paint has a vivid green.
In spring, the mountains are dyed green.

notes:
⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ (green) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). The explicit color-name form, used when specifying or describing the color green precisely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緑色|みどりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: green vegetables
- {緑色|みどりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to shine green
- {緑色|みどりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed green
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧{緑色|みどりいろ}: dark green
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{緑色|みどりいろ}: light green

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: green — used more broadly and poetically; {緑色|みどりいろ} is more concrete and descriptive
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧: blue/green — traditionally covers both blue and green in Japanese; traffic lights are called ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ even though they appear green

USAGE:
In Japanese, ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ historically encompassed both blue and green. The distinction between ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ and ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ became clearer in modern Japanese, but ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ is still used for green traffic lights and green apples (⟦{青|あお}りんご→青りんご：27445_aoringo⟧). {緑色|みどりいろ} is unambiguously green.
